verdict.rationale: Grafana publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probe found grafana.com/api/openapi.json with an "openapi" key), so a buyer could load its API into an interactive explorer. Nothing in the evidence shows a first-party interactive API reference or runnable, try-it examples. Missing for 10: a documented interactive API explorer (e.g. Swagger UI or try-it console), runnable code examples in the reference, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the API docs experience.
